name: use-api-keys
title: useApiKeys
description: useApiKeys: the api-keys block's controllers as React hooks, for React DOM and React Native.
docs: Needs the api-keys block (`npx better-supabase add api-keys`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/api-keys.
